name: Renstant. Restavracija trupa
source: Lnezhberat is a promising psyatic specialist studying the culture of an extinct civilization. A new order from the server commandant shocks the researcher - now he must recreate the last day of the psyaque world for a popular virtual attraction. Rejection is unacceptable, but it's almost impossible to get the job done... unless he admits that psyaques aren't actually extinct, and one of them is his worst nightmare.
translation: Lnezhberat是一位很有前途的精神病学专家，研究已灭绝文明的文化。服务器指挥官的新命令震惊了研究人员 - 现在他必须为一个受欢迎的虚拟景点重建灵能世界的最后一天。拒绝是不可接受的，但完成工作几乎是不可能的……除非他承认灵能者实际上并没有灭绝，而其中之一是他最糟糕的噩梦。
